description: This file defines a set of reusable Flutter widgets primarily for UI components such as cards, chips, empty states, progress bars, and transaction list items. It is part of a Flutter frontend project and integrates with app-specific models and constants.

classes.name: CardShell
classes.description: A custom widget providing a stylized card surface with optional tap handling.

classes.name: PillChip
classes.description: A compact, customizable filter chip widget with primary/secondary color states.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A widget to display an icon, title, message, and optional action when there is no data.

classes.name: BudgetProgress
classes.description: A linear progress indicator widget showing budget usage with color transitions based on thresholds.

classes.name: TransactionListItem
classes.description: A widget representing a transaction row with category badge, note, date, and amount.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget, describing the widget's layout and behavior.

methods.name: _colorFor
methods.description: Determines the color of the progress bar based on the spent/total ratio.
